## Objective
- Complete the German-language turn-based zombie shooter “Dust & Bones” set in Red Creek.
- Add collectible power-ups, enterable buildings, and consistently name the cowboy Rick and the dogs Safi and Lou.

## Requirements
- Keep the standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript game and its western setting.
- Include Call of Duty-inspired collectible power-ups.
- Make buildings enterable.
- Use Rick, Safi, and Lou consistently.

## Decisions
- Power-ups: Medkit (+2 health), ammo (+3 rounds), adrenaline (+1 action), and damage boost (+1 damage).
- Building interiors use traversable floor space, perimeter walls with door openings, and blocked furniture.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added power-up spawning, collection on Rick’s movement, effects, and map rendering in `game.js`; pickups spawn at the start of each wave.
- Renamed the cowboy and dogs throughout the game logic, HUD, intro, upgrades, and game-over text.
- Added pathfinding-based movement for Rick and follower movement for dogs.
- Updated building collision footprints and door openings.
- `node --check game.js` passed.

- Verify building appearance, door alignment, and movement through interiors.
- Test wave flow, power-up collection/effects, and dog/zombie navigation in a browser.

- (none)

1. Browser-test wave start, pickups, and interior traversal.
2. Check that Safi, Lou, and zombies can navigate around buildings and furniture; adjust movement/pathfinding if needed.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game state, rendering, collision, movement/pathfinding, turns, combat, and power-ups.
- `index.html`: Game HUD, character names, overlays, and controls.
- `style.css`: Game presentation and responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Legacy DOM IDs for Rick’s health were renamed to `rickHealthBar` and `rickHealthText`; dog status IDs are `safiStatus` and `louStatus`.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Complete “Dust & Bones,” the German-language turn-based zombie game, with smoother character controls and automatic firing when Rick targets an enemy.
- Set the city Rick protects to Garath.

## Requirements
- Keep the standalone HTML/CSS/JavaScript game and western setting.
- Include power-ups and enterable buildings.
- Use Rick, Safi, and Lou consistently.
- Add smartphone-friendly controls.
- Make character movement feel fluid; aiming at an enemy should make Rick shoot automatically.
- The city Rick protects is Garath.

## Decisions
- Power-ups: Medkit (+2 health), ammo (+3 rounds), adrenaline (+1 action), and damage boost (+1 damage).
- Building interiors use traversable floor space, perimeter walls with door openings, and blocked furniture.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added power-up spawning, collection, effects, and map rendering in `game.js`.
- Renamed the cowboy and dogs throughout game logic, HUD, intro, upgrades, and game-over text.
- Added pathfinding-based Rick movement and follower movement for Safi and Lou; movement highlights follow reachable paths and pickups are collected along routes.
- Updated building collision footprints and door openings.
- Added a mobile reload button, touch-control guidance, and mobile layout adjustments; hid keyboard instructions on narrow screens.
- Browser-tested at 390×844: game starts, canvas taps move Rick, mobile guidance appears, keyboard controls are hidden, and `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` pass.

### Active
- Implement smoother-feeling character controls and automatic shooting on enemy targeting.
- Update the protected city name to Garath.
- Continue testing mobile layout and game behavior; a 390px viewport showed horizontal overflow (`scrollWidth` 375, `innerWidth` 390).

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect and update movement and enemy click handling in `game.js` to deliver smooth controls and automatic shots when targeting.
2. Update city references in `index.html` and `game.js` to Garath.
3. Retest phone-sized layout and gameplay, including touch targeting and shooting.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game state, movement, pathfinding, combat, rendering, and city text.
- `index.html`: HUD, controls, overlays, and intro copy.
- `style.css`: Mobile layout and touch-control presentation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked in the current Git status.
